consequence.statement: A new split interval option is introduced for recent metadata queries to help caching; the evidence states no operational consequence for operators.

original.statement: Loki adds a new config option split_recent_metadata_queries_by_interval, a separate split interval applied to recent_metadata_query_window to help cache recent metadata query results.

decision.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line [ev-c04ff0f14724]. It lists this under Features as a new, separate split interval option for recent metadata queries, meant to help caching. It says nothing about anything failing, being rejected or ignored, or needing migration, so no action-eligible kind is supported. It also states no new default that would change behaviour when the option is left unset, so behavior-change isn't supported either and 'none' (informational) is the best-supported reading. Confidence is low because the excerpt doesn't state the default value or whether the option has any effect when unset.
